messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: metric embed_gen_latency_usw > 95th x3. Pager triggered for embeddings latency in US‑West. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/incidents/embed-gen-latency. Potential customer impact: delayed embeddings (10–30s). @sylvie (oncall) please ack.

sylvie (oncall): acked. Investigating now. Bringing up extra workers in genpool-4.

chris (sre): Copy — checking genqueue backlog and GPU util. If we see sustained backpressure we'll reroute a portion of traffic to the compatible model variant.

miguel: Ops draft for status page below, quick edits welcome:

```
Initial: We are investigating increased latency for embedding generation in US‑West. A subset of requests may experience delays or timeouts. Engineering is investigating and routing mitigations are in progress.
```

ops-comm: Suggested edits: add ETA for next update (30m) and a short workaround (reduce parallel requests / retry). Also ping legal for customer-facing wording.

legal: quick ack — avoid the word 'outage' unless error rate threshold exceeded. Use 'increased latency' and avoid absolute impact percentages unless we can verify.

l10n-bot: tagging l10n for FR/DE/JP translations of the status copy. ETA ~45m.

chris (sre): Update: genqueue backlog is ~110% of target, KV cache hit rate normal. Scaling up now.

```
# scale genpool
kubectl scale deployment genpool-4 --replicas=6 -n prod
```

Executing scale.

sylvie (oncall): Scale executed. Observability: p95 dropped from ~18s -> ~6s within 45s. Still above baseline. Preparing to enable fallback routing for a portion of traffic.

miguel: Draft snippet for status update (30m):

```
Update (30m): We have routed a portion of traffic to a compatible model variant in US‑West to reduce impact while queues drain. Performance is improving; we expect normalization in the next 30–60 minutes. No data loss is expected.
```

ops-comm: Good. Publishing initial statuspage draft to staging (includes affected region: US‑West; affected APIs: embeddings, search). @legal approved the phrasing.

incident-bot: statuspage draft published to staging: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1755000000-draft

l10n-bot: FR/DE translations done, JP in progress.

miguel: Quick customer impact estimate: ~2% of embedding requests in US‑West saw >10s latency during the peak window; most requests returned successfully after retry/backoff.

ops-comm: Sounds good. @sylvie please confirm when p95 stabilizes to publish resolved. We'll hold 10m of stable metrics before marking resolved.

sylvie (oncall): p95 stabilized ~0.6s after scale + partial fallback. Holding 10m window now.

chris (sre): No increase in 5xx observed. Rolling back fallback routing gradually to normal routing as capacity holds.

ops-comm: Draft resolved copy: 

```
Resolved: The increased latency for embedding generation in US‑West has been resolved. P95 latency returned to normal and the temporary routing fallback has been removed. If you continue to see issues, please contact support.
```

legal: OK to publish.

incident-bot: RESOLVE_ACTION: mark incident resolved at 1755000360

ops-comm: Resolved notice published to status and customer-facing channels. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
